question: At 99 Elizabeth St, which points stopped reporting or look stalled over the last week?
answer: 67 points not reporting at all, all dead the entire week (no fresh mid-week outage). Two families: ~34 VSD points on CT/tenant-CW/car-park-exhaust drives (CT-1/2-VSD, TSCWP-2-VSD, CPEF-VSD) = actionable dead-comms cluster; ~33 system-generated Estimated/Substituted meter channels (PM-AEE-E, WM-AEE-E) = benign by design. Of 146 measured temp sensors scanned, ZERO flat-lined; only 3 constant signals were setpoints holding steady (normal).
scope_strategy: Site has 3574 favourites - full pull infeasible. (1) cheap site-wide history_available(24h) pass to isolate 67 non-reporters; (2) full history only for a ~150-point sensor subset for the flat-line variance check.
cheap_staleness_check_used: history_available(start,end) scalar boolean, paginated, no rows; re-queried false-set over full week to split stopped-mid-week vs dead-all-week.
deviations: Guideline was aggregation-only; lacked (1) scoping for whole-site DQ, (2) cheap history_available staleness probe, (3) flat-line-vs-off variance + semantic rule, (4) stopped-vs-dead triage. ALL added in new Data-quality section. NOTE: worker claimed history(latest:true) is buggy -> I VERIFIED it works (returned latest sample for a known-good fav); claim NOT propagated.
